_meta.experiment: branch data-lab; not merged into the pipeline

states.in_table: recorded for n of N mapped tests (tests.csv)
states.column_in_sampled_raw_file: empty in the table; one sampled file of a group has a column (or a key in a text file) whose header names the quantity; 'column_is' says what kind of column
states.documented_only: a document sentence states it for the whole table (sources.json 'documented_elsewhere')
states.not_in_sampled_files: empty in the table and in the mapped columns of the sampled files; the unopened files are listed by kind; where the quantity is, if anywhere, is not stated
states.no_test_table: the investigation has no per-test table

column_is.sensor_reading_series: a time series of an instrument channel
column_is.value_per_test_in_a_results_file: one value per test row or per-test file in a file of results or test records
column_is.setting_or_set_point: a setting, set point or planned value
column_is.calculated_by_the_workbook: a value the workbook calculates (formula cells)
column_is.event_timestamp: the time of an event or step
column_is.operator_entry: a choice entered by the operators
column_is.calibration_example: a calibration or a worked example, not a value per test
column_is.unclear: the file does not say which of the above

header_kinds.column header: the header cell of a table column
header_kinds.column header with the unit in the next: a header cell with the unit in the cell below
header_kinds.key in a text file: the name of a 'key = value' or 'key: value' line of a text file, not a column header

_meta.count_keys: In the per-need counts a test in state column_in_sampled_raw_file is counted under 'column_in_sampled_raw_file:<column_is>' (several kinds joined by '+').
_meta.order_rule: States are tried in this order: in_table, column_in_sampled_raw_file, documented_only, not_in_sampled_files; no_test_table applies before all of them.
_meta.caution: A header in a sampled raw file says only that the file has such a column or key. One file per group was opened; the files do not say whether the values are complete, calibrated, or for the same test as a row of the table.
_meta.sampling: Only one file per group was opened; other files of a group may have other columns.
_meta.not_opened: Archives (.zip) and videos were not downloaded or opened; what they hold is not known.
_meta.reason: No file read states why a quantity is not in the experimental table.
_meta.mapping_by: AI reading of the header, not confirmed by a document
_meta.mapping_rule: A header is mapped to a standard variable only when its text names the variable's quantity (unit differences are noted). A column of a different quantity, location or event, or a column with no values in the sampled file, is not a column for the variable: it is listed under 'related_columns_not_mapped' with the reason, and is not counted. Where several statistics exist for one variable, each is listed with its header and the note says they are different statistics. 'column_is' is one of the words of '_meta.column_is', decided from the file and the checker review.
